intro.text: You wake up in a strange glowing room. Three mysterious doors stand before you.

dragon.text: You open the red door. Heat races through your body as scales spread across your skin, your frame expands, and powerful wings unfold behind you. You have transformed into a dragon.

wizard.text: You open the blue door and begin transforming into a wizard.

vampire.text: You open the green door and begin transforming into a vampire.

dragonCrossroads.text: You spread your wings and leap into the sky. A vast mountain range stretches before you. Where will Drakon go?

dragonMountains.text: Drakon beats his enormous wings and climbs toward the frozen mountain peaks. Snow whips across his scales as he spots a ruined stone fortress built into the cliffside. A deep roar echoes from somewhere inside.

dragonFortress.text: Drakon lands on the ancient stone fortress. Broken towers surround him. A gigantic golden egg rests on a pedestal in the center of the ruins.

dragonEgg.text: As Drakon approaches, the enormous golden egg begins to glow. Tiny cracks spread across its shell. Something inside taps back when he touches it.

dragonHatch.text: The golden shell cracks apart in a burst of warm light. A tiny dragon emerges, blinking up at Drakon before letting out a squeaky roar.

dragonProtectHatchling.text: Drakon curls one immense wing around the tiny hatchling. The baby chirps happily and presses against his scales. From deep within the fortress, heavy footsteps begin approaching.

dragonShell.text: The shattered shell glitters with ancient runes. One fragment pulses with magical energy while another contains a faded map.

dragonCarryEgg.text: Drakon carefully lifts the golden egg. It is surprisingly warm. As he carries it away, the fortress begins to shake violently.
